verdict.rationale: For a coding assistant, the user's data is their code and repositories, and Copilot natively generates suggestions and insights from it. It offers code completions and next-edit suggestions, code review feedback with severity-ranked issues and one-click suggested changes, and Autofix explanations with fix suggestions for vulnerabilities. missing for 10: insights over non-code data such as analytics, usage, or project metrics are not evidenced; no independent hands-on corroboration of the review and insight features beyond anecdotal completion praise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: GitHub Copilot can review your code and provide feedback. Where possible, Copilot's feedback includes suggested changes which you can apply with a couple of clicks.
Copilot labels each comment with a severity level of "High," "Medium," or "Low" to help you prioritize the issues it finds based on their importance.
GitHub Copilot Autofix provides contextual explanations and code suggestions to help developers fix vulnerabilities in code
Unlimited code completion and next edit suggestions
